import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF1187G extends PrintWriter {
    public CF1187G() { super(System.out); }
    
    static class Input {
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[1 << 15];
        private int ptr, len;
        private final InputStream is;
        
        Input(InputStream s) { is = s; }
        
        private int next() throws IOException {
            if (ptr >= len) {
                len = is.read(buf);
                ptr = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[ptr++];
        }
        
        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while ((c = next()) <= 32) if (c == -1) return -1;
            int x = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                x = x * 10 + c - '0';
                c = next();
            }
            return x;
        }
    }
    
    Input in;
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        CF1187G solver = new CF1187G();
        solver.in = new Input(System.in);
        solver.execute();
        solver.flush();
    }
    
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    List<Integer>[] adj;
    int N, M;
    int[] u, v, uv;
    int[] cap, origCost, redCost;
    int[] flow;
    
    void build(int n, int m) {
        N = n;
        M = m;
        adj = new ArrayList[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        u = new int[M];
        v = new int[M];
        uv = new int[M];
        cap = new int[M];
        origCost = new int[M];
        redCost = new int[M];
        flow = new int[M];
    }
    
    void add(int a, int b, int c, int cost) {
        int idx = M++;
        u[idx] = a;
        v[idx] = b;
        uv[idx] = a ^ b;
        origCost[idx] = cost;
        redCost[idx] = cost;
        cap[idx] = c;
        flow[idx] = c;
        adj[a].add(idx);
        adj[b].add(idx ^ 1);
    }
    
    boolean findPath(int s, int t) {
        int[] dist = new int[N];
        int[] lvl = new int[N];
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(lvl, 0);
        dist[s] = 0;
        
        PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((x, y) -> {
            if (x[0] != y[0]) return x[0] - y[0];
            if (x[1] != y[1]) return x[1] - y[1];
            return x[2] - y[2];
        });
        pq.add(new int[]{0, 0, s});
        
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = pq.poll();
            int d = cur[0], level = cur[1], node = cur[2];
            
            if (d != dist[node]) continue;
            int nextLvl = level + 1;
            
            for (int e : adj[node]) {
                if (cap[e] <= 0) continue;
                int idx = e >> 1;
                int cost = (e & 1) == 0 ? redCost[idx] : -redCost[idx];
                int nd = dist[node] + cost;
                int to = node ^ uv[idx];
                
                if (nd < dist[to] || (nd == dist[to] && lvl[to] > nextLvl)) {
                    dist[to] = nd;
                    lvl[to] = nextLvl;
                    pq.add(new int[]{nd, nextLvl, to});
                }
            }
        }
        System.arraycopy(dist, 0, this.dist, 0, N);
        System.arraycopy(lvl, 0, this.lvl, 0, N);
        return dist[t] != INF;
    }
    
    int[] dist, lvl;
    
    int dfs(int node, int sink, int f) {
        if (node == sink || f == 0) return f;
        int nextLvl = lvl[node] + 1;
        
        for (int e : adj[node]) {
            if (cap[e] <= 0) continue;
            int idx = e >> 1;
            int cost = (e & 1) == 0 ? redCost[idx] : -redCost[idx];
            int to = node ^ uv[idx];
            
            if (dist[to] == dist[node] + cost && lvl[to] == nextLvl) {
                int pushed = dfs(to, sink, Math.min(f, cap[e]));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    cap[e] -= pushed;
                    cap[e ^ 1] += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    int solve(int s, int t) {
        System.arraycopy(origCost, 0, redCost, 0, M);
        int total = 0;
        
        while (findPath(s, t)) {
            while (dfs(s, t, INF) > 0) {}
            
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
                if (dist[u[i]] != INF && dist[v[i]] != INF) {
                    redCost[i] += dist[u[i]] - dist[v[i]];
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            total += origCost[i] * (cap[i ^ 1]);
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    void execute() {
        try {
            int n = in.nextInt();
            int m = in.nextInt();
            int k = in.nextInt();
            int c = in.nextInt();
            int d = in.nextInt();
            
            int[] special = new int[k];
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) special[i] = in.nextInt() - 1;
            
            List<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                int a = in.nextInt() - 1;
                int b = in.nextInt() - 1;
                g[a].add(b);
                g[b].add(a);
            }
            
            int T = k + 1;
            int totalNodes = n * T + 1;
            int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (T - 1);
            build(totalNodes, totalEdges);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                    int u = i * T + t;
                    for (int neighbor : g[i]) {
                        int v = neighbor * T + t + 1;
                        for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                            add(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                    int u = i * T + t;
                    int v = u + 1;
                    add(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
                }
            }
            
            int source = totalNodes - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                add(source, special[i] * T + 0, 1, 0);
            }
            
            int sink = 0 * T + T - 1;
            println(solve(source, sink));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
